title: The theme library is a two-column index with a full sales page per theme, read from one catalog
detail: /themes is a two-column index with a full-kit picture per theme; /themes/[theme] is the sales page for the six themes without their own page (Midnight keeps /themes/midnight). Both read lib/themes/library.ts, SITE_THEMES and KIT_INDEX, mark each surface ready or on the way from what ships, list every tool and look control, and show a labeled empty slot until a picture is listed in lib/themes/library-assets.ts. Open follow-ups from the survey (themes/library/THEME-LIBRARY-SURVEY.md): a General stock kit per theme, Spotlight presets for five themes, email surfaces for six, a theme parameter on Space creation, demos for six themes, 42 pictures from the owner.

verify.evidence: Probe passes; render tests cover the index and all six kit pages.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const f=require("fs");for(const p of ["app/(marketing)/themes/[theme]/page.tsx","lib/themes/library.ts","lib/themes/library-assets.ts"])if(!f.existsSync(p)){console.error(p+" is gone");process.exit(1)};if(!f.readFileSync("components/frequency/site/pages/themes/frequency-themes.tsx","utf8").includes("THEME_LIBRARY")){console.error("index no longer reads the catalog");process.exit(1)}'
